title: VoiceDesign
description: One presentation identity's public casting brief: what a voice actor is told to produce, and the two lines it is judged on. This is deliberately not a character dossier. It names no hidden identity, anchors no canon, and carries nothing about unplayed plot, because the same record reaches prompts, provider previews and logs — a field added here would leak three ways at once, and 'we did not think to use it' is not a control.

design_id.description: Stable content identifier of the brief itself, not of the character. Retained across revisions so a task can name the brief it was cast from.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for a listener choosing whom to cast. Never a hidden or canonical identity.

presentation_identity.description: The identity a binding scope names. Two designs may not share one: 'which voice does this character have' must not depend on file order.

usage.description: Narration is the storyteller's channel; at most one design may claim it, so 'the narrator' is never ambiguous at render time.

design_revision.description: Content revision of this brief. Recorded on the task so a later edit shows up as a different casting rather than a silent change under an old one.

public_traits.description: Short audible adjectives. Public by construction: shown in a picker and sent to the provider.

voice_description.description: The casting brief in prose: timbre, pitch, pace, affect, and what to avoid.

validation_text.description: A line the voice has not been tuned on. A cross-text check against the reference proves nothing, which is why a repeat is refused at load rather than quietly accepted.
